text.en: The shortest verse form carries the biggest ideas.

Thirukkural is a two-line couplet form (kural venba) in which Thiruvalluvar speaks on virtue, wealth and love. The textbook gives selected couplets in this iyal, linked to the theme of arts and beauty.
Each kural is brief but has deep meaning. We should learn its words, its meaning and a daily-life example.
Revise the three parts: அறத்துப்பால், பொருட்பால், காமத்துப்பால் (இன்பத்துப்பால்). Learn how each chapter has ten kurals.
